name: Whirlwind
flavour: Every swing is a full circle, four a stroke; a swing that crits refunds 20% of the cooldown. Flurry doubles the swings, Riposte speeds them and Critical Thinking's crits refund them: it hardly stops spinning.
art_prompt: a broad curved scimitar with a brass guard spinning in a full circle, a pale cyan ribbon of wind trailing the blade
